title: Certify masked E8 decoder padding transfers
body:
## Summary

Add `research/masked-e8-padding-transfer/`, an independently implemented check and reusable rational-candidate CLI for Philippe Van Velzen's [masked-line reduction](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-18956000).

```text
valid decoder on L, cost c
  zero-extend factors
  add one singleton per missing line
valid masked P120 decoder, cost c + 120 - |L|
```

The written proof retains restriction, disjoint gluing and the equivalence between the conjectural all-subset gain-48 law and `C(P120)>=72`. The reduction and prior checker retain Philippe's credit. PR717/DreamingOfClouds and PR968/themilkman216 retain model and fixture credit.

## Evidence

- Before, the predecessor supplied the reduction and generic examples. This adds source-authenticated upstream P104/both P111 fixtures, a candidate-padding CLI and explicit all-pairs scope checks, without importing predecessor executable code.
- Five fixtures have costs 72, 64, 63, 63, 56; all pad to masked P120 cost 72. Two exact binary-rank engines agree on every occurrence. All 64 restrictions of one six-line domain and disjoint gluing pass.
- Padding breaks the all-pairs Gram identity on 896 / 1,000 / 1,000 / 1,728 entries for the punctured fixtures. This is not an extension of the eight-term all-pairs theorem.
- Registered and optimized CPython 3.12.15 replay, eleven actual-CLI test groups, 70 research-workflow tests, scoped lint and a Git-free read-only export pass.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/masked-e8-padding-transfer
```

Base `936fac15b1b1b59dc5285c713a77f9f3c07b2906`, priority revision 5. The drawn `coverage-law-change` scope was changed explicitly to this audit after overlap checks. Exact heads, hashes, environment, limitations and next questions are in the package. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-18958290). Final overlap covered 710 open PRs and 1,399 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** research.

Only a new opt-in package. No selected record or frozen source changes. This does not prove the general P120 floor, supply a cheaper decoder, establish native/physical supplier costs or claim a new kappa. Full selected cold replay, independent human review and formal-kernel verification are not claimed.
